blocks.text: Allah Ta’ala par bharosa ek momin ke liye saans lene jitna aasaan hona chahiye. Is ke bawajood imaan ka da’wa karne wale bahut se log Allah ke siwa har cheez par bharosa rakhne ko zyada tayyar nazar aate hain. Aur jab halaat un ki tawaqqo ke mutabiq nahi hote to woh achanak Allah ki marzi par sawal uthane lagte hain.

blocks.text: Tawakkul ka matlab Allah Ta’ala par apna poora bharosa rakhna hai. Lekin tawakkul ka yeh matlab hargiz nahi ke kyunke Allah Ta’ala sab kuch dekhne wala aur har cheez par qadir hai, is liye insaan pahad ke kinare par khara ho kar baghair kisi sahare ke neeche kood jaye aur yeh umeed rakhe ke Allah us ka girna rok lega. Tawakkul ka yeh ghalat tasavvur hai.

blocks.text: Balke tawakkul yeh hai ke insaan poori tayyari kare, apni tamam koshishen karne ke baad is baat par bharosa rakhe ke agar woh natija Allah Ta’ala ki marzi mein hai to zaroor pesh aayega. Aur agar poori duniya kisi kaam ke liye har mumkin mansuba bana le, lekin woh anjaam Allah Ta’ala ki marzi mein na ho, to tamam waqt, mehnat aur maal lagane ke bawajood woh hargiz pesh nahi aayega.

blocks.text: Tawakkul yeh nahi ke jab insaan ka socha hua mansuba us ke mutabiq poora na ho to woh naraz aur ghusse mein aa jaye. Nahi! Tawakkul yeh hai ke insaan is yaqeen ke saath safar kare ke mansuba bandi mein apni har mumkin koshish karne ke bawajood Allah ka mansuba sirf behtareen mansuba nahi, balke wahi wahid mansuba hai jo poora ho kar rahega. Is liye us mansube ke anjaam ko qabool karna chahiye, kyunke Allah behtar jaanta hai. blocks.text: Is doodh pilane ke hukm mein do badi hikmaton ke moti chhupe hue the. Ek par bab ke aage chal kar guftagu hogi; doosri ko samajhne ke liye khud soorat-e-haal par ghaur karna hoga, jo yaqeenan bahut sakht rahi hogi. Socho: sipahi naye paida hone walon ko dhoond rahe hain, aur naye paida hone wale bachche se yeh umeed bhi nahi ki ja sakti ke woh soorat-e-haal ko samjhe, kyunke woh abhi duniya mein aaya hi tha. Aisi soorat mein maa ke do bunyadi masail the. Pehla aur sab se zahir masla bachche ki hifazat tha, aur doosra use chhupa kar rakhna tha. Lekin naya bachcha kisi bhi waqt ro sakta hai, aur use lapet kar khamosh rehne ko kaha nahi ja sakta. Is liye jab sipahi qareeb hote, bachche ki hifazat ka behtareen zariya yeh tha ke use doodh pilaya jaye. Jab bachcha doodh pi raha hota hai to sipahiyon ki maujoodgi ke dauran woh khamosh rehta hai, aur maa ko apne bachche ki hifazat ka behtar mauqa mil jata hai.
